fields.title: IMPORTANT WARNINGS (click to open)
fields.text:
**Responsibility of the declarant**

- The declarations contained in this form are provided **under the full responsibility** of the declarant who is liable for them in the event of a false or mendacious declaration, even criminally (as required by art. 76 of Presidential Decree 445/2000).
- If the check carried out by the University reveals an untruthful content of the declarations, **the declarant will forfeit any benefits** obtained on the basis of the false declaration.

**Remind**

In addition to sending this declaration, **do not forget** 

- To make the request using the specific function provided by the **Esse3 booking system**
- **To send the receipt of this form** to the professor in charge of the exam or to the President of the graduation Committee

** References **

- For further information consult the [Operational indications for exams and final tests](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1N_llPsXmiZRTpNAQw824u3wEESNi9fH0/view?usp=sharing) drawn up on the basis of *Article 12 of Rector's Decree 1159,  27 August 2021* and *Articles 7 and 8 of [Rector's Decree 198, 6 January 2022](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NdBUVw3-rbTH-Dr3sfKAbIFiGppDuTe4/view?usp=sharing)*
